risk_if_not_implemented: Without Human-in-the-Loop Workload & Manipulation, AI and autonomous systems may produce unreliable, biased or unsafe outputs, act outside authorized scope, or expose sensitive data. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to AI Output / Decision Integrity Failure (R-AI-1), Unauthorized / Harmful Autonomous Action (R-AI-3), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Workforce Shortage / Loss of Critical Skills / Labor Disruption (MT-25), Adversarial Artificial Intelligence (AI) Attack (MT-29).

compensating_control_1.name: Separation of Duties (SoD)
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to implement and maintain Separation of Duties (SoD) to prevent potential inappropriate activity without collusion.
compensating_control_1.justification: Separation of Duties (SoD) (HRS-14) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Human-in-the-Loop Workload & Manipulation (AAT-41) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Least Privilege
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize the concept of least privilege, allowing only authorized access to processes necessary to accomplish assigned tasks in accordance with organizational business functions.
compensating_control_2.justification: Least Privilege (IAC-30) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Human-in-the-Loop Workload & Manipulation (AAT-41) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
